Name: Martha
Summary: Martha was Mary and Lazarus's sister in Bethany who welcomed Jesus into her home and confessed Him as the Messiah before her brother was raised. Jesus loved this family dearly.
KeyStory: Distracted by serving, Martha was gently corrected by Jesus, and later at Lazarus's tomb she declared, I believe You are the Messiah, the Son of God.
LifeLesson: Martha's story holds both service and faith: Jesus invites busy hearts to sit, listen, and believe. At a graveside she confessed hope — and then watched her brother walk out alive.
